actual_actions.reason: Positive exact B-rep intersections with both corresponding fixed guide rails invalidate the tested dual-pivot motion path.
The evidence applies to the exact tested pivots/path/current rail geometry only and does not generalize to all pivoting architectures.
Further densification of the same failed motion path has low diagnostic value after decisive positive interference; investigation should change architecture or geometry assumptions instead.

conclusion: The exact v43 dual-independent-pivot POP path is disproven by verified guide-rail B-rep interference. Candidate A's closed contact topology remains useful, but this particular opening law is exhausted. Broader pivoting, translating-carrier, and moving-wrap-belt architecture classes remain unresolved. PLAN-0011 stays in mechanism engineering with the next test required to change the candidate motion architecture rather than resample the failed path.
